verdict.rationale: Bugbot findings link straight into a fix flow. "Fix in Web" opens the issue in cursor.com/agents, where Cloud Agents work on branches and open PRs, and "Fix in Cursor" opens it in the IDE; inline comments also carry suggested fixes. However, both fix paths take the developer out of the PR into Cursor's own surfaces. No evidence shows a fix committed back to the PR branch from the review comment itself. missing for 10: in-PR one-click apply/commit of a suggested fix, documented autofix that pushes a patch to the PR branch, end-to-end docs of the Fix in Web agent flow, independent/hands-on corroboration of the fix workflow.
